content.about: Fiji is a group of over 300 islands in the South Pacific. It has coral reefs, rainforests and beaches. Rugby sevens is hugely popular. Bula is a common greeting.

standout.text: Fiji's Great Astrolabe Reef is one of the largest barrier reefs in the world.

didYouKnow: Fiji has won Olympic gold in rugby sevens.
About a third of its islands are inhabited.
